newsitem.title: USA: U.S. bulk millfeeds-Some nearby supplies are tight.
newsitem.headline: U.S. bulk millfeeds-Some nearby supplies are tight.

text.p: Some nearby supplies remain tight in several locations across the U.S., several brokers said.
In southern California, demand for mids are still strong and the mills are continuing to run, one dealer said.
"I am getting some calls looking for mids," a Minnesota broker said. But he noted supplies are tight and people are having a difficult time trying to obtain corn.
"Perhaps people waited too long after the holiday to get back into the market," he said.
As Hurricane Fran slammed through North Carolina Thursday night, one Carolinas broker said he heard that several North Carolina feed mills had no power Friday and are not up and running yet.
"This (also) makes corn supplies hard to get," he said.
